description_sq:
VILE NE SHITJE NE ZONEN E SHKOZES, PRANE UNAZES SE MADHE
480,000 €
Sip. Totale 640m2
Shesim vile ne zonen e shkozes 2 minuta nga unaza e madhe. Vila ndodhet ne nje zone rezidenciale.
Ne total eshte 640 m2 ndertim dhe siperfaqe trualli 479.8 m2.
Ne katin -1 disponon garazh te mbyllur dhe depo.
Ne katin 0 ,me akses individual e shkeputur nga pjesa tjeter e viles, ndodhet nje hapesire komerciale open space per evente me guzhine dhe 2 tualete me siperfaqe totale 272.3 m2.
Ne katin e pare banim gjendet verande, salloni , 2 dhoma gjumi , guzhine e vecuar dhe nje tualet me sipefaqja totale 148.8 m2.
Ne katin e dyte ndodhen te njejtat hapsira por me siperfaqe totale 137.9 m2.
Dy katet e banimit kane shkalle te jashtme po ashtu dhe shkalle te brendshme.
Vila eshte e veshur me sistem kapot te standartit gjerman per te siguruar izolimin termik maksimal qe kjo teknologji mundeson. Dritaret jane me duralumin termik dupleks. Shitet e mobiluar si ne foto.
Per me shume info apo nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni.
title_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN THE AREA OF SKOZA, NEAR THE GREAT RING €480,000 Sip. Total 640m2
description_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN THE AREA OF SKOZA, NEAR THE GREAT RING €480,000 Sip. Total 640m2 Villa for sale in the area of ​​Shkoza, 2 minutes from the big ring road. The villa is located in a residential area. In total, there is 640 m2 of construction and 479.8 m2 of land area. On the -1st floor, there is a closed garage and a storage room. On the 0th floor, with individual access separated from the rest of the villa, there is an open space commercial space for events with a kitchen and 2 toilets with a total area of ​​272.3 m2. On the first floor, there is a veranda, a living room, 2 bedrooms, a separate kitchen and a bathroom with a total area of ​​148.8 m2. On the second floor, there are the same spaces, but with a total area of ​​137.9 m2. The two residential floors have external stairs as well as internal stairs. The villa is covered with the German standard kapot system to ensure the maximum thermal insulation that this technology enables. The windows are with duplex thermal duralumin. For sale furnished as in the photo. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us.
